notes: v8 with T7 boost_gain retired and T8 boost_edge in its place: sqrt(self/100) - sqrt(opp/100), paid every step at weight 0.01. v8 priced the transition (acquiring boost) when the replay study had measured the state (boost differential, AUC 0.618); at 200M it collected more boost than v7 (216 vs 187/min) while holding half as much (tank 9.1 vs 16.3, empty 63% vs 33%) because the ratchet paid the rise and never charged the fall, making a collect/dump cycle profitable and, under a concave phi, most profitable at the bottom of the tank. T8 reads the level, so no cycle pays, and it is a differential so the two cars cancel every step and a dense bonus cannot become a survival bonus. Everything else is v8's, unchanged: terms, gamma, scenario mix, replay pruning, mirroring and natural tag frequencies. Lineage start is v5, since v6, v7 and v8 were not adopted.
